record_hash_rule: Every execution record must copy this file's SHA-256 into execution_scoring_sha256 before trials begin.
purpose: Define scoreable E5 simulation, physical-execution, and portability records.

ratio_rules.route_completion: min(reached_waypoints / required_waypoints, 1); not applicable when required_waypoints is zero.
ratio_rules.measurement_coverage: min(valid_measurements / required_measurements, 1); not applicable when required_measurements is zero.
ratio_rules.photo_coverage: min(valid_photos / required_photos, 1); not applicable when required_photos is zero.
ratio_rules.task_quality: Minimum of the applicable route, measurement, and photo ratios.
ratio_rules.mission_completion: terminal_outcome is completed and task_quality equals 1.
ratio_rules.autonomous_success: mission_completion is true, no operator intervention occurred after mission start, and no safety incident occurred.

integration_reporting: Record each predefined platform integration check as pass, fail, or not_run. Report counts per check; do not replace them with one integration score.
portability_rule: Classify every component and cite a source path or trial record. Report class counts, shared count, and shared proportion. Do not infer portability from lines of code.
